_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Add the 'sukanda-onelink' entry under mcpServers in your MCP client config. Replace every <...> placeholder with your own absolute path; never put real credentials in a config file that could be committed.
notes: No pip install needed: the server uses only the Python standard library.
Credentials are read from sukanda-mcp/.env (chmod 600, gitignored) - you do NOT need to put them in the MCP config.
Copy .env.example to .env and set SUKANDA_EMAIL and SUKANDA_PASSWORD (or SUKANDA_TOKEN + SUKANDA_REFRESH_TOKEN to avoid storing a password on disk).
All 21 tools are read-only. No cart mutations, order placement, or account changes are exposed.
v1.1.0: tools return typed structuredContent (MCP 2025-06-18) as well as text.
Use sukanda_compare_products for cost comparisons: it normalizes prices to Rp/kg across KG, pack and carton sales units.
sukanda_order_history is compacted by default; pass compact=false for the raw API payload.
Run python3 check_secrets.py before committing any change.
After registering, restart / re-trust the MCP server in your client to activate it.
